item.title: 2,800-Mile 2022 Acura NSX Type S
item.description: This 2022 Acura NSX is #193 of the 350 Type S examples produced, and it has 2,800 miles through the seller's purchase in 2023. It is finished in Gotham Gray Matte Metallic over black and red upholstery and is powered by a twin-turbocharged 3.5-liter V6 linked to three electric motors, a nine-speed dual-clutch automatic transaxle, and Acura's Super Handling All-Wheel-Drive system. item.title: 2k-Mile 2021 Ferrari 812 GTS
item.description: This 2021 Ferrari 812 GTS has 2k miles and features an Extra Range Grigio GTS exterior finish, which is accented by airbrushed Scuderia Ferrari fender shields. item.title: 8k-Mile 2005 Lotus Elise
item.description: This 2005 Lotus Elise has 8k miles, and it was optioned with the Touring Package and a removable roof panel. Finished in Ardent Red over black leather, the car is powered by a 1.8-liter inline-four paired with a six-speed manual transaxle. Equipment also includes 16" and 17" eight-spoke alloy wheels, power windows, a Pioneer head unit, and air conditioning. This Elise is now offered by the selling dealer with a window sticker, a clean Carfax report, and a clean Illinois title.

item.title: 30k-Mile 2006 Aston Martin DB9 Volante 6-Speed
item.description: This 2006 Aston Martin DB9 Volante is finished in Merlot Red over Kestrel Tan leather and is powered by a 5.9-liter V12 linked with a six-speed manual transaxle and a limited-slip differential. The car has spent time on both coasts and in Utah and now has 30k miles. item.title: 19k-Mile 1995 Ferrari F355 GTS 6-Speed
item.description: This 1995 Ferrari F355 GTS is powered by a 3.5-liter DOHC V8 paired with a six-speed manual transaxle, and it now shows 19k miles. The car was acquired by the seller on BaT in October 2021, and it was subsequently modified with Capristo exhaust components and Fabspeed 200-cell catalytic converters. item.description: This 1994 Porsche 911 Carrera 4 is one of 267 factory-widebody coupes delivered to the North American market, and it was purchased by the current owner in 2002. Powered by a 3.6-liter flat-six that drives all four wheels through a rebuilt five-speed manual transaxle, it is finished in Polar Silver Metallic over black leather upholstery.
